statement.p:
Suppose the statement,
"If the circle is orange, then the square is purple,"
is true. Assume also that the converse is false. Classify each statement below as true or false (if possible).

li.p: The circle is orange if and only if the square is not purple.
The circle is orange if and only if the square is purple.

solution.p: The only way for an implication P\rightarrow Q to be true but its converse to be false is for Q to be true and P to be false. Thus we know that square is purple and that circle is not orange.
